title: Canvas inheritance across theme reload

install.basis: real candidate source checkout in its repository virtual environment

terminal.program: Talaria via POSIX PTY on macOS

actions:
Imported a dark theme and configured category backgrounds to inherit. Real assistant plain text, Markdown and code rendered on the dark canvas without white or grey category fills.
Changed the canvas to brown and reloaded; the same retained transcript followed the new canvas. The code block retained its own syntax surface, distinct from a category background.
